tags.documentation: Set true to request a waveform collection. Cleared automatically once the command is published.
tags.name: collect_request

eventScripts.script:
# One-shot observer request out to the local vibration gateway.
	# Fires on the rising edge of steady_state && collect_request.
	if initialChange or not currentValue.value:
		return
	
	import sys
	
	# Lines of resolution the gateway accepts: powers of two, 512 .. 4194304.
	LOR_VALUES = [512 << i for i in range(14)]
	
	logger = system.util.getLogger("vibration_sensor.collect")
	base = tagPath.rsplit("/", 1)[0]
	
	topic, gwSerial, channelIndex, resolution = [
		qv.value
		for qv in system.tag.readBlocking([
			base + "/mqtt_topic",
			base + "/gw_serial",
			base + "/channel_index",
			base + "/resolution",
		])
	]
	
	if not topic or not gwSerial or resolution is None:
		logger.warn(
			"collect skipped for %s: mqtt_topic, gw_serial or resolution is unset" % base
		)
		return
	
	# Comes back as a java.lang.Long off an Int8 tag; coerce before the membership test.
	resolution = int(resolution)
	if resolution not in LOR_VALUES:
		logger.warnf(
			"collect skipped for %s: resolution %s is not one of %s",
			base, resolution, LOR_VALUES
		)
		return
	
	payload = {
		"type": "observerrequest",
		"channelIndex": channelIndex,
		"action": "wiredcollectnow",
		"settings": {
			"lor": resolution,
			"sendto": "cloud",
		},
		"gwSerial": gwSerial,
	}
	
	try:
		system.cirruslink.transmission.publish(
			"chariot_broker", topic, system.util.jsonEncode(payload), 1, False
		)
	except:
		logger.error("collect handoff to %s failed" % topic, sys.exc_info()[1])
		return
	
	# publish() neither raises nor returns a status when MQTT Transmission
	# drops the message - it logs its own warning under ClientsManager. So
	# this line means handed to the module, NOT delivered to the broker.
	logger.infof(
		"wiredcollectnow handed to %s for %s ch=%s lor=%s",
		topic, gwSerial, channelIndex, resolution
	)
	
	# Stamp when we asked, then one-shot clear the request so the next collect
	# needs a fresh trigger. This timestamp and the capture time that comes back
	# on the waveform are the whole of this pattern's request/response story -
	# there is no correlation id, because the PM system does not need one.
	system.tag.writeBlocking(
		[base + "/last_request_ts", base + "/collect_request"],
		[system.date.now(), False],
	)
